verdicts.reason: Both break the original's even three-bar stack. The NEW YORK bar is much bigger than SUBWAY and GUIDE, its text is indented differently from the other two, and the grey stripe shapes float in the middle of the photo as a broken 'A' glyph, with a faint ghost copy at the left. A also spreads the bars apart with uneven gaps (larger before GUIDE). B keeps the bars in a tighter, more even group closer to the original, but still has the same size mismatch and the stray shapes.
